config.ompPath.description: Path to the omp CLI binary (oh-my-pi). Defaults to `omp` resolved via PATH (~/.bun/bin is added automatically).
config.language.description: Language of the chat interface. Independent of the VS Code display language, so the editor can stay English while the chat is Russian. Command titles and these setting descriptions still follow VS Code itself.
config.language.enumDescriptions.0: Follow the VS Code display language
config.customProviders.markdownDescripti: Custom model providers, same shape as the `providers:` map in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`. Merged into models.yml before each agent start. Example: `{"akemi": {"baseUrl": "http://host:8000/v1", "api": "openai-completions", "apiKey": "sk-...", "models": [{"id": "akemi-1", "name": "Akemi", "contextWindow": 128000, "maxTokens": 32000}]}}`
config.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model to select after the agent starts, as `provider/modelId` (fuzzy matched), e.g. `akemi/akemi-1` or `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`. Empty = keep the agent's default.
config.verifyModels.markdownDescription: Before offering a model, send it one throwaway request (`ping`, thinking off, no tools) through a separate session-less agent and keep only the models that answer. Hides models whose credentials are stale or whose subscription does not cover them. Verdicts are cached for 12 hours; refresh them from the model picker's "Re-check subscriptions".
config.hideStartupNotices.markdownDescri: Hide the agent's internal startup notices (`xd://: mounted …`, `inspect_image is now hidden …`). Warnings and errors are always shown; suppressed notices still go to the "OMP Code" output channel.
config.resumeLastSession.markdownDescrip: When a new chat opens, resume the most recent omp session (across all workspaces) instead of starting blank.
config.thinkingLevel.description: Thinking (reasoning) level applied after the agent starts.
config.approvalMode.markdownDescription:
Tool approval tier, passed to omp as `--approval-mode`. Also settable from the `access:` chip in the chat composer.

Note: approving a single `task` call hands its subagent the same tier, so an approved task can run shell commands without asking again.
config.approvalMode.enumDescriptions.0: Auto-approve reads; ask before writing files or running commands.
config.approvalMode.enumDescriptions.1: Auto-approve reads and file writes; ask before running commands.
config.theme.description: Accent palette of the chat panel. Applied live, without restarting the agent.
config.theme.enumDescriptions.1: Coral accent (#D97757), the original Claude Code palette.
config.accentColor.markdownDescription: Override the palette accent with a custom CSS color, e.g. `#8B7BF7` or `hsl(250 85% 72%)`. Empty = use `ompcode.theme`.
config.modelProfiles.markdownDescription:
Per-model behaviour profiles, layered on top of the built-in ones. Each entry is `{ family, match: { id?, provider?, host? }, contextFile?, badge?, runtime?, spawn? }`; `match.id` is a regular expression **as a string**. Your rows always win over the built-ins, whatever their specificity.

Only policy belongs here — omp already resolves the thinking dialect, the effort ladder, stream timeouts and tool-schema shape per provider, and overriding those makes things worse, not better.

Example — never let one model run shell commands unattended:

```json
[{ "family": "qwen", "match": { "id": "qwen" },
   "spawn": { "overlay": { "tools.approval": { "bash": "prompt" } } } }]
```
